# 1 Clement Chapter 58 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 58 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_058_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 58

**58:1** So let us obey his all-holy and glorious name, and steer clear of the threats Wisdom has just warned about — finding our security in the supremely holy name of his majesty.

**58:2** Take our advice, and you will have no regrets. We swear by the living God, by the Lord Jesus Christ, and by the Holy Spirit — the faith and hope of the chosen — that anyone who with humility and steady, consistent gentleness, without regret, has kept the ordinances and commands that God has given will certainly be counted among those who are saved through Jesus Christ. To him be glory forever and ever. Amen.

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the spirit of Clement's pastoral appeal.*
